acceptance_matrix.basis: Identical ordered Quote/Trade ticks plus immutable configuration produce identical canonical Fill IDs and replay digest; latency, partial liquidity, limit/stop handling and scoped calibrated slippage are deterministic; sequence disorder/gaps and clock anomalies are typed fail-closed outcomes.
acceptance_matrix.limitations: No external representative market dataset is claimed; capability is L3 replay semantics for research.

acceptance_matrix.basis: Depth and queue transitions enforce conservation, aggressive and resting fills cannot exceed eligible liquidity, partial fills and price-time queue behavior match the frozen truth sample, and randomized properties cover depth and queue boundaries.
acceptance_matrix.limitations: The truth sample is a synthetic golden oracle and is not exchange-specific queue calibration.

acceptance_matrix.basis: The connector-neutral Paper boundary maps local orders without claiming venue acceptance, normalizes canonical external fills, reconciles complete local/external order and fill sets, and treats unknown health/state, mismatch and unsupported TqSim behavior as failure rather than success.
acceptance_matrix.limitations: No deployment credentials or live TqSim/Paper observation were available; L5 remains disabled.
